test_objectives.statement: Under the app-context 404 scenario, calling abort(404) is expected to raise an Exception whose string contains "Aborted with 404".
test_objectives.condition: S1: has_app_context is True, code=404, args=(), kwargs={}.

test_objectives.statement: Under the app-context 500 scenario with a message argument, calling abort(500, "Internal Server Error") is expected to raise an Exception whose string contains "Aborted with 500".
test_objectives.condition: S2: has_app_context is True, code=500, args=("Internal Server Error",), kwargs={}.

test_objectives.statement: Under the no-app-context 403 scenario, calling abort(403) is expected to raise an Exception whose string contains "Werkzeug abort 403".
test_objectives.condition: S3: has_app_context is False, code=403, args=(), kwargs={}.

test_objectives.statement: Under the no-app-context 400 scenario with args and kwargs, calling abort(400, "Bad Request", description="Invalid input") is expected to raise an Exception whose string contains "Werkzeug abort 400".
test_objectives.condition: S4: has_app_context is False, code=400, args=("Bad Request",), kwargs={"description": "Invalid input"}.

test_objectives.statement: Under the app-context custom-code scenario, calling abort(418, description="I'm a teapot") is expected to raise an Exception whose string contains "Aborted with 418".
test_objectives.condition: S5: has_app_context is True, code=418, args=(), kwargs={"description": "I'm a teapot"}.
